pages.title: Sunday power-up: Youth room
pages.summary: Switch the youth room on for a gathering (about 5 minutes).
pages.body:
## 1. Power

- [ ] Switch on [[device:youth-pdu]] in the wall rack — the switch [[device:youth-sw]] and receiver [[device:youth-wrx-1]] come up with it.

## 2. Audio

- [ ] Power on [[device:youth-mixer]] and recall scene **1 Youth**.
- [ ] Switch on [[device:youth-spk-l]] and [[device:youth-spk-r]] (rear switches).
- [ ] Check both handhelds show RF on [[device:youth-wrx-1]].

## 3. Video

- [ ] Pick input **1 Laptop** on [[device:youth-hdmi-sw]]; power on [[device:youth-proj]].

## 4. Lighting

- [ ] Switch on [[device:youth-lx-ctrl]] and press scene **Warm**.
